answer: Each challenge is derived from a specified future drand quicknet round, whose threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable before release and publicly verifiable afterward. Participants commit to a session before the pulse; the revealed value then fixes the task, so precomputed answers cannot anticipate it. Automated sybil swarms must solve each live challenge independently, whether it concerns an inlet, nebula, or haven, rather than farming reusable answers offline.
